info.name: ZBR — Restos menu import
info.description:
Pulling a venue's menu from a Restos POS, including the case where this server cannot reach the venue at all.

Set access_token to a token for an account that owns the local restaurant, or any ADMIN/PLATFORM token.

item.name: 1. Fetch venue menu (their server, no auth)

request.description:
The VENUE's endpoint, not ours. Run it from a machine that can reach them.

Copy the ENTIRE response body — the {"success": true, "data": [...]} object, envelope included — and paste it into request 4 as the value of "payload".
Fetches the menu and returns it without writing anything. Fails if this server cannot reach the venue — which is the case for Qahvoon today.

item.name: 3. Import by fetching (needs a working route)

request.description:
The normal path. baseUrl is the HOST only — no /api/v1, the client appends the rest itself.

overwriteExisting=false creates what is new and leaves existing items alone. true updates in place and may deactivate items missing from the menu.

For a venue this server cannot reach.

Replace PASTE_THE_WHOLE_RESPONSE_FROM_REQUEST_1_HERE with the entire body from request 1 — including {"success": true, ...}, not just the array.

If you already have just the array, send it as "categories" instead. Exactly one of the two: both, or neither, is refused rather than guessed at.

Same rules as a fetched import: matched by the venue's ids, their prices charged as sent, DRAFT and ARCHIVED items skipped, and a run that would deactivate more than 30% of their live items refuses and changes nothing.
